tagline: Plan your day. Keep your momentum.
brief: A fast, simple, mobile-first personal planner for daily Moves, Arcs, Streaks and Sparks. It should feel instant, focused and forward-moving, never busy.
criteria: Success: avoids checkbox and calendar clichés, reads at 16 px as a favicon, makes a strong home-screen icon, works in one colour.

concepts.name: Rising M
concepts.idea: An M whose right peak climbs higher, with a checkmark hidden in its stroke.
rationale: Carries the name and works alone as an app icon
The climbing peak says each day builds on the last
The hidden check nods to done Moves without a checkbox cliché
Monoline with round ends: same construction as the wordmark

recommendation: Rising M: white on #FF5A1F for the app icon, orange on white elsewhere.
next_steps: Use in the app (icon, favicon, header)
Trademark search before any public launch
